questions.q: Which data type should store a temperature of 36.75 °C?
questions.qAf: Watter datatipe moet 'n temperatuur van 36,75 °C stoor?
questions.explain: A double stores decimals; an int stores only whole numbers.
questions.explainAf: 'n double stoor desimale getalle; 'n int stoor net heelgetalle.

questions.q: Which line will give an error?
questions.qAf: Watter reël sal 'n fout gee?
questions.explain: 85.5 is a decimal, so it cannot be stored in an int.
questions.explainAf: 85.5 is 'n desimale getal, dus kan dit nie in 'n int gestoor word nie.

questions.q: Which two attributes are compulsory in the tag?
questions.qAf: Watter twee attribute is verpligtend in die -etiket?
questions.explain: src is the path to the file and alt the alternative text; width and height are recommended.
questions.explainAf: src is die pad na die lêer en alt die alternatiewe teks; width en height word aanbeveel.

questions.q: A learner wants a list numbered A, B, C. Which opening tag must they use?
questions.qAf: 'n Leerder wil 'n lys hê wat A, B, C genommer is. Watter openingsetiket moet die leerder gebruik?
questions.explain: A numbered list is an ordered list, <ol>; type="A" gives capital letters.
questions.explainAf: 'n Genommerde lys is 'n geordende lys, <ol>; type="A" gee hoofletters.

questions.q: A range of 10 cells holds 7 numbers, 2 names and 1 empty cell. What does =COUNTA give?
questions.qAf: 'n Reeks van 10 selle bevat 7 getalle, 2 name en 1 leë sel. Wat gee =COUNTA?
questions.explain: COUNTA counts every cell that is not empty: 7 + 2 = 9. COUNT would give 7 and COUNTBLANK 1.
questions.explainAf: COUNTA tel elke sel wat nie leeg is nie: 7 + 2 = 9. COUNT sou 7 gee en COUNTBLANK 1.

questions.q: What is the next number in the pattern 2, 5, 10, 17, 26, …?
questions.qAf: Wat is die volgende getal in die patroon 2, 5, 10, 17, 26, …?
questions.explainAf: Verskille +3, +5, +7, +9; volgende +11: 26 + 11 = 37.

questions.q: How many degrees of freedom does a circle have?
questions.qAf: Hoeveel vryheidsgrade het 'n sirkel?
questions.explain: Two for the centre (horizontal and vertical) and one for the radius.
questions.explainAf: Twee vir die middelpunt (horisontaal en vertikaal) en een vir die radius.

questions.q: How many degrees of freedom does a freely drawn line have?
questions.qAf: Hoeveel vryheidsgrade het 'n lyn wat vry geteken is?
questions.explain: Up/down, left/right, length and angle.
questions.explainAf: Op/af, links/regs, lengte en hoek.

questions.q: Which Arduino pin can produce a PWM signal for motor speed?
questions.qAf: Watter Arduino-pen kan 'n PWM-sein vir motorspoed lewer?
questions.explain: Only pins marked with a tilde (~3, ~5, ~6, ~9, ~10, ~11) produce PWM.
questions.explainAf: Net penne met 'n tilde (~3, ~5, ~6, ~9, ~10, ~11) lewer PWM.

questions.q: A motor must run at 40% power. Which PWM value is correct?
questions.qAf: 'n Motor moet teen 40% krag loop. Watter PWM-waarde is korrek?

questions.q: Which range of numbers does analog input (0–5 V) give?
questions.qAf: Watter reeks getalle gee analoë inset (0–5 V)?
questions.explain: Analog input gives 0 to 1023; analog output accepts 0 to 255.
questions.explainAf: Analoë inset gee 0 tot 1023; analoë uitset aanvaar 0 tot 255.

sections.title: True or false
sections.intro: Decide whether each statement is true or false.
sections.introAf: Besluit of elke stelling waar of onwaar is.

questions.q: Text in Java is stored in a String, written in double quotes.
questions.qAf: Teks in Java word in 'n String gestoor, tussen dubbele aanhalingstekens.
questions.explain: For example String name = "Lebo";. String starts with a capital letter because it is an object type.
questions.explainAf: Byvoorbeeld String name = "Lebo";. String begin met 'n hoofletter omdat dit 'n objektipe is.

questions.q: External CSS is preferred, because one .css file can style many pages.
questions.qAf: Eksterne CSS word verkies, want een .css-lêer kan baie bladsye stileer.
questions.explain: One external file can style 50+ pages; inline CSS is the worst way.
questions.explainAf: Een eksterne lêer kan 50+ bladsye stileer; inlyn-CSS is die swakste manier.

questions.q: A Revolve sketch must be a closed shape on one side of the axis.
questions.qAf: 'n Revolve-skets moet 'n geslote vorm aan een kant van die as wees.
questions.explain: It must also be fully constrained.
questions.explainAf: Dit moet ook volledig beperk wees.

questions.q: A digital output can only be HIGH (5 V) or LOW (0 V).
questions.qAf: 'n Digitale uitset kan net HIGH (5 V) of LOW (0 V) wees.
questions.explain: Analog control gives a range of values (0 to 255) for finer control.
questions.explainAf: Analoë beheer gee 'n reeks waardes (0 tot 255) vir fyner beheer.

questions.q: A servo motor must be connected through an L293D motor driver.
questions.qAf: 'n Servomotor moet deur 'n L293D-motordrywer gekoppel word.
questions.explain: A servo needs no L293D: 5 V, GND and a signal wire to a ~ pin.
questions.explainAf: 'n Servo het geen L293D nodig nie: 5 V, GND en 'n seindraad na 'n ~-pen.

sections.title: Matching
sections.intro: Match column A to column B, and find the matching pairs.
sections.introAf: Pas kolom A by kolom B, en vind die pare wat bymekaar pas.

questions.q: Match each chart in column A with what it is best for in column B.
questions.qAf: Pas elke grafiek in kolom A by waarvoor dit die beste is in kolom B.
pairs: Parts of a whole, e.g. pass vs fail
pairsAf: Dele van 'n geheel, bv. slaag teenoor druip
extra: Relationships between two sets of values
questions.explain: The extra description is a scatter plot.
questions.explainAf: Die ekstra beskrywing is 'n spreidingsdiagram.

questions.q: Find the matching pairs: link each pillar of computational thinking to its meaning.
questions.qAf: Vind die pare wat bymekaar pas: koppel elke pilaar van berekeningsdenke aan sy betekenis.
pairs: Breaking a complex problem into smaller, manageable parts
Identifying repeated sequences, trends or logic
Focusing on what matters and filtering out unnecessary detail
A clear, step-by-step set of instructions
pairsAf: Om 'n komplekse probleem in kleiner, hanteerbare dele op te breek
Om herhalende reekse, neigings of logika te identifiseer
Om op die belangrike te fokus en onnodige besonderhede uit te filter
questions.explain: These are the four pillars of computational thinking.
questions.explainAf: Dit is die vier pilare van berekeningsdenke.

questions.q: Making a sandwich: match each part in column A with its place in the IPO model in column B.
questions.qAf: 'n Toebroodjie maak: pas elke deel in kolom A by sy plek in die IPO-model in kolom B.
pairsAf: Smeer, voeg by, maak toe en sny
questions.explain: IPO sorts a task into Input (what is needed), Process (the work done) and Output (the result).
questions.explainAf: IPO sorteer 'n taak in Inset (wat nodig is), Verwerking (die werk wat gedoen word) en Uitset (die resultaat).

questions.q: Match each sketch state in column A with its description in column B.
questions.qAf: Pas elke sketstoestand in kolom A by sy beskrywing in kolom B.
pairs: Zero DOF left; the sketch turns green
It still has degrees of freedom and can move
Too many constraints that conflict; it shows orange
pairsAf: Nul DOF oor; die skets word groen
Dit het nog vryheidsgrade en kan beweeg
Te veel beperkings wat bots; dit wys oranje
extra: The sketch has been padded into 3D
extraAf: Die skets is met Pad 3D gemaak
questions.explain: Fully constrained (green, zero DOF) is the goal for every sketch. Under-constrained can still shift; over-constrained has conflicting constraints (orange).
questions.explainAf: Volledig beperk (groen, nul DOF) is die doel vir elke skets. Onderbeperk kan nog skuif; oorbeperk het botsende beperkings (oranje).

questions.q: Match each constraint in column A with what it does in column B.
questions.qAf: Pas elke beperking in kolom A by wat dit doen in kolom B.
extra: Sets the size of a circle
questions.explain: The extra description is the Radius constraint.
questions.explainAf: Die ekstra beskrywing is die Radius-beperking.

sections.title: Missing syntax
sections.intro: Type the missing symbol or word in each box.
sections.introAf: Tik die simbool of woord wat ontbreek in elke blokkie.

questions.q: Type the two symbols missing from this for loop.
questions.qAf: Tik die twee simbole wat in hierdie for-lus ontbreek.
questions.explain: The three parts of a for loop (initialisation, condition, increment) are separated by semicolons.
questions.explainAf: Die drie dele van 'n for-lus (inisialisering, voorwaarde, inkrement) word deur kommapunte geskei.

questions.q: Type the symbols that start each kind of comment.
questions.qAf: Tik die simbole waarmee elke soort kommentaar begin.
questions.fill:
Java:  [[]] draw the next side
HTML:  [[]] main menu -->
CSS:   [[]] page colours */
questions.fillAf:
Java:  [[]] teken die volgende sy
HTML:  [[]] hoofkieslys -->
CSS:   [[]] bladsykleure */
questions.explain: Java uses // for a single-line comment, HTML uses <!-- … -->, and CSS uses /* … */. Comments are not run or displayed.
questions.explainAf: Java gebruik // vir 'n eenreël-kommentaar, HTML gebruik <!-- … -->, en CSS gebruik /* … */. Kommentaar word nie uitgevoer of vertoon nie.

questions.q: Type the two symbols missing from this CSS rule.
questions.qAf: Tik die twee simbole wat in hierdie CSS-reël ontbreek.
questions.explain: A declaration is property : value, and each pair ends with a semicolon.
questions.explainAf: 'n Deklarasie is eienskap : waarde, en elke paar eindig met 'n kommapunt.

sections.title: Scenarios
sections.intro: Read each scenario, then answer the questions about it.
sections.introAf: Lees elke scenario en beantwoord dan die vrae daaroor.

questions.scenario: Thabo writes this program to make his Gogga, bob, walk around a square.
questions.scenarioAf: Thabo skryf hierdie program om sy Gogga, bob, om 'n vierkant te laat loop.

questions.q: How many times does bob.move() run altogether?
questions.qAf: Hoeveel keer word bob.move() altesaam uitgevoer?
questions.explain: The inner loop moves 3 times per side and the outer loop repeats it for 4 sides: 4 × 3 = 12.
questions.explainAf: Die binneste lus beweeg 3 keer per sy en die buitenste lus herhaal dit vir 4 sye: 4 × 3 = 12.

questions.q: How many times does bob turn right?
questions.qAf: Hoeveel keer draai bob regs?
questions.explain: turnRight() is inside the outer loop but outside the inner loop: once per side, 4 times.
questions.explainAf: turnRight() is binne die buitenste lus maar buite die binneste lus: een keer per sy, 4 keer.

questions.q: What is counter++ short for?
questions.qAf: Waarvoor is counter++ kort?
questions.explain: counter++ adds 1 to counter; it is the increment of the loop.
questions.explainAf: counter++ tel 1 by counter; dit is die inkrement van die lus.

questions.q: Thabo wants each side to be 5 moves long. What must the inner condition become?
questions.qAf: Thabo wil hê elke sy moet 5 bewegings lank wees. Wat moet die binneste voorwaarde word?
questions.explain: Starting at 0, counter < 5 runs 5 times (0 to 4).
questions.explainAf: Met 0 as begin word counter < 5 vyf keer uitgevoer (0 tot 4).

questions.q: Thabo could use the name counter for both loops.
questions.qAf: Thabo kan die naam counter vir albei lusse gebruik.
questions.explain: The inner and outer loops must use different variable names, otherwise the computer gets confused.
questions.explainAf: Die binneste en buitenste lusse moet verskillende veranderlikename gebruik, anders raak die rekenaar deurmekaar.

questions.scenario: Lerato types the cost of one T-shirt (R80) in B1. The shirts sold each day are in B3 to B12. In C3 she types =B3*B1 and drags it down.
questions.scenarioAf: Lerato tik die koste van een T-hemp (R80) in B1. Die hemde wat elke dag verkoop is, is in B3 tot B12. In C3 tik sy =B3*B1 en sleep dit af.

questions.q: In C4 the formula became =B4*B2 and shows 0. Why?
questions.qAf: In C4 het die formule =B4*B2 geword en dit wys 0. Hoekom?
options: B1 is a relative reference, so it moved to the empty B2
optionsAf: B1 is 'n relatiewe verwysing, dus het dit na die leë B2 geskuif
questions.explain: A relative reference moves with the formula when it is copied.
questions.explainAf: 'n Relatiewe verwysing skuif saam met die formule wanneer dit gekopieer word.

questions.q: Type the symbols that lock B1 so the formula copies down correctly.
questions.qAf: Tik die simbole wat B1 sluit sodat die formule korrek afkopieer.
questions.explain: $B$1 is an absolute reference: the dollar signs lock the column and the row.
questions.explainAf: $B$1 is 'n absolute verwysing: die dollartekens sluit die kolom en die ry.

questions.q: Which formula shows the most shirts sold on one day?
questions.qAf: Watter formule wys die meeste hemde wat op een dag verkoop is?
questions.explain: MAX gives the largest value in the range.
questions.explainAf: MAX gee die grootste waarde in die reeks.

questions.scenario: Naledi connects an LED to an Arduino pin that gives 5 V. The LED drops 2 V, and she wants a current of 12 mA (0.012 A).
questions.scenarioAf: Naledi koppel 'n LED aan 'n Arduino-pen wat 5 V gee. Die LED se spanningsval is 2 V, en sy wil 'n stroom van 12 mA (0,012 A) hê.

questions.q: What voltage must the resistor take?
questions.qAf: Hoeveel spanning moet oor die resistor val?

questions.q: Which resistor does she need?
questions.qAf: Watter resistor het sy nodig?

questions.q: The resistor must be in series with the LED.
questions.qAf: Die resistor moet in serie met die LED wees.
questions.explain: In series, the same current flows through both, so the resistor limits it and protects the LED.
questions.explainAf: In serie vloei dieselfde stroom deur albei, dus beperk die resistor dit en beskerm die LED.
